paras: VW Golf MK5, MK6, MK7, MK7.5 all feature a red plastic reflector on the bottom of the door card, a safety feature to increase visibility when doors are open at night.

However, by replacing the standard reflectors with our bright door LED Projector lights, it will increase visibility by ten-fold. Bright red LEDs illuminating to make sure other road-users are aware, and the logo projecting downwards for that "extra" detail.
